sre-bot: incident-bot: PagerDuty page fired -> INC-2025-078: spike of 5xx on /v1/generate in eu-west-1 (canary pool: v2.3.7) :rotating_light:
pd-bot: PagerDuty alert: https://pd.example/INC-2025-078 — urgency: high — triggered by latency/5xx threshold (5m window)
sam (oncall): acked — I'm oncall for the next 30m, handing off if needed :wave:
alex (eng-runtime): on it. rolling up traces now. can anyone confirm traffic fraction for the canary?
maria (sre): confirmed — canary started @ 12:02 UTC, 5% traffic split to v2.3.7 (rule: stagewave-release). Observed p50->p95 jump and 5xx rate from ~0.1% -> 3.8% in eu-west-1
emily (prod-sd): support: we've got 7 customer reports in EU complaining about 500s and long tails, samples attached in Zendesk #3739
alex (eng-runtime): grabbing logs. looks like tokenization step in the new tokenizer flavor fails on some payloads — stack: Tokenizer::normalize -> segfault -> 502 upstream
sam (oncall): @alex can we drop canary traffic to 0 while you validate? need to stop customer impact asap
alex (eng-runtime): yes — will set weight 0 and scale down pods. doing `kubectl -n inference set resources deployment model-canary --replicas=0` ? that won't undo stateful caches, better to flip traffic routing
maria (sre): option: set trafficSplit(stagewave-release)=0 using traffic controller. command:
```
# drain canary traffic
redwood traffic set --policy stagewave-release --canary-weight 0 --confirm
```
Doing now.
```
(maria executed the command)
```
maria (sre): traffic at 0% for canary — monitoring for 30s
sre-bot: metric update: 5xx rate in eu-west-1 for /v1/generate dropped from 3.8% -> 0.9% (30s window)
alex (eng-runtime): still seeing some errors in canary pods logs — initiating rollback of canary image to v2.3.6 to be safe. Command:
```
redwood rollout rollback --service model-serving --to-version v2.3.6 --scope canary
```
pd-bot: PagerDuty note added: rollback in progress by alex
sam (oncall): good. I've added incident tag P0 and notified support lead @emily. pls keep updates every 5m
emily (prod-sd): posting customer advisory template to #support-templates for CS to send; will update affected ticket list once we confirm full mitigation
alex (eng-runtime): rollback completed, canary pods now at v2.3.6 and healthy. k8s shows 3/3 ready for canary set.
sre-bot: metric update: p95 latency back to baseline, 5xx down to 0.2% over 2m window in eu-west-1
maria (sre): confirming no new PD alerts for the endpoint in the last 4m. marking incident as mitigated.
pd-bot: PagerDuty: INC-2025-078 moved to "acknowledged" -> "resolved" by sam (oncall) (auto-resolve condition met)
sam (oncall): resolving here. great quick work everyone. immediate mitigation: traffic flipped and rollback. next steps: small postmortem, root cause looks tokenizer change in v2.3.7. @alex please capture failing payloads and a minimal repro
alex (eng-runtime): will capture repro and open PR to revert tokenizer change for the next release candidate. linking logs: https://logs.example/repro/INC-2025-078
emily (prod-sd): support will follow up with affected customers and offer remediation guidance. I'll coordinate comms and include timeline + ETA for patch
maria (sre): follow-up actions: (1) add canary healthcheck for tokenizer errors (2) add alert to correlate tokenizer segfaults -> higher priority (3) run 1000 randomized tokenization samples in CI for next RC. I'll file the tasks
sam (oncall): thanks all. I'll add a short incident note and assign postmortem to alex + maria. closing thread when postmortem link available :thumbsup:
pd-bot: Incident INC-2025-078 resolved — summary: canary v2.3.7 triggered 5xx spike in eu-west-1, mitigated by traffic flip and rollback to v2.3.6. Customer reports: ~7 tickets.
